cross_verification.note_en: The Visa Code (Regulation (EC) No 810/2009) is the EU-wide legal basis for Schengen visa photos, but EUR-Lex's own pages (HTML and PDF endpoints, multiple CELEX/consolidation variants) returned no readable content via automated fetch across repeated attempts, and the EEAS 'How to Apply for a Schengen Visa' PDF and France-Visas page were likewise unreadable/blocked (403). As a working substitute, the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs' official consular portal (Netherlands Worldwide), which implements the same EU-wide Visa Code as every Schengen state, was used to confirm size/background/validity. Size (3.5×4.5cm) and background (white/light) match the DB exactly — no conflict. Head height and detailed composition/expression/glasses/headwear rules were not stated on this specific checklist page and remain unverified rather than filled from third-party aggregators.
